basic_details.job_title: Finance Department Maharashtra Retired Accounts Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Government of Maharashtra, Finance Department has invited applications for the recruitment of 1 Retired Accounts Officer on a contract basis for a period of 1 year at the Finance Department, Mantralaya, Mumbai. Interested and eligible retired accounts officers may submit their applications via email to [email protected] by 04.11.2026.

qualification.details: Educational and Service Qualification: The candidate must be a retired accounts officer or retired from that post in ministerial service, with a minimum of 3 years of experience in updating state debt statistics, reconciliation, examining budget estimates for fund-raising proposals by borrowers, and checking government guarantee proposals and loan accounts. Age Limit: Not more than 65 years of age. Residency: The candidate must reside in Mumbai or adjacent districts. Disciplinary Record: There should be no departmental inquiry pending or proposed against the candidate. Language Proficiency: The candidate must have knowledge of Marathi and English languages.

selection_process: interviews will be conducted for the selection of candidates. The complete power regarding candidate selection remains with the department.
important_instructions: The appointment is made on a contract basis for a period of 1 year. The appointed retired accounts officer shall work under the control of the respective Joint Secretary / Deputy Secretary. Applications received without the prescribed format or after the last date will be summarily rejected. Canvassing in any form or failure to meet the required qualifications and experience will result in disqualification. Other terms and conditions will remain as per the General Administration Department's Government Resolution dated 10.06.2025.

content_sections.heading: About Finance Department Maharashtra Retired Accounts Officer
content_sections.text: The Finance Department of the Government of Maharashtra, located at Mantralaya, Mumbai, operates from the Extension Building at Hutatma Rajguru Chowk, Madam Cama Road. The department handles updating state debt statistics, reconciliation, examining proposals regarding fund-raising by borrowers as well as government guarantee proposals, and work related to loan accounts.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Email Address: [email protected] Applications received after the last date or incomplete applications without necessary details will not be considered, and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained. Also, applications from retired accounts officers who do not possess the required qualification and experience will not be considered, and no correspondence or replies will be given to such applications.
